notes.title: May 2025 - Dev Update on Final Demo
notes.content:
Greetings, folks!

It’s been a hot minute, but we’re back with some very important updates to share with you all. So strap in, because it’s a bit of a doozy…

Let’s get the big one out of the way. As you may recall, we had promised in previous dev updates that we are looking to release the next and final [i]Winds of Arcana: Ruination[/i] demo for the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition. However, after much discussion with the team, we have taken the decision to push the Final Demo to [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2025 Edition (October 13 to October 20)[/b].

This was not a simple nor easy decision for us to make. But after reviewing all the feedback we’ve gathered since the last four physical events, the IGU Steam demo (which you can still play!), content creators and our amazing community - we felt it was the right call to delay the Final Demo to October 2025. We do apologize for not being able to meet this deadline. With that being said, this new target date will give the team ample time to incorporate all the shiny new features, fixes and polish that we know will make a huge difference to our players.

Now for some good news! [b]We’ve already internally begun testing the full version of [i]Winds of Arcana: Ruination[/i].[/b] While we cannot immediately comment on when the exact release date will be, what this does mean is that we are one step closer to completing the game and ensuring that the release will be sometime towards the end of 2025. This is a HUGE milestone for us and we hope to talk more about it when we get closer to the Steam Next Fest: October 2025 Edition. So be on the look out for that and news about the Final Demo.

Lastly, we just want to once again extend our thanks to the support of our community and friends. As mentioned before, we received a lot of incredibly valuable feedback from those who took the time to message or leave a comment on the Steam forums and our [url=bit.ly/3n3imoo]Discord Channel[/url]. We take the time to go through everything (and we do mean EVERYTHING) and ensure that you guys are being heard. 

But while there’s no Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition demo, that doesn’t mean we won't have stuff to show off. In fact, we’re planning a little something special on our Discord Channel next month. So if you haven't already, do join us for the latest updates and come say hi while you’re there! 

Until next time! Talk to you soon.

<3,
Team Brewed Games

notes.title: March 2025 Dev Update
notes.content:
Greetings, folks!

It’s been a hot minute, but we have some news to share on the development progress of Winds of Arcana: Ruination. 

Firstly, we really want to thank everyone who provided feedback on our downloadable PC Demo 2.0. All your Steam forum posts, your messages on our [url=http://bit.ly/3n3imoo]Discord[/url] community, as well as what several content creators had to say… we combed through it all! It’s because of your valuable time and feedback that we are able to shape WoA:R into something special.

Now let’s get into the meat of it! Here’s what we’ve changed and added since our last showing:

[list]
[*] Fine-tuned and improved the combat system
[*] Brand new animations for Aryn.
[*] Updated VFX and SFX. 
[*] Added a whole bunch of side-quests with new characters!
[*] Not to mention some new tracks for exploration and battle!
[/list]

And that is just the tip of the iceberg. We have even more things added and built for the game that, unfortunately, we’re not able to show you just yet. However, that leads us into our next announcement…

Brewed Games is coming to GDC 2025 in San Francisco and we’ll be showing the latest WoA:R build to the public! This is a huge milestone for us as we’ll be able to directly interact with fans from across the world as they get to experience what you’ve been helping us brew (hah)! 

If you would like to attend any of the events we are attending during GDC week, keep an eye out on socials or Discord for more information. Lastly, we know you guys are hungry for another playable demo. While we can’t say anything for certain just yet, we are definitely looking forward to doing something soon-ish. Fingers and swords crossed!

That’s all we have for now. We’ll be back with more news to share in the coming weeks. Thank you so much for your support! We’ll see you guys very soon ;-)

<3,
Team Brewed Games

notes.title: Major DEMO update!
notes.content:
[b]Hello folks! [/b]

We are glad to present the [b]DEMO 2.0[/b] for our game!
After receiving a lot of feedback for our last demo (released 1.5 months back), we decided to incorporate them into the game along with other improvements. This version is packed with more action and features, offering a clearer glimpse of what the full game will deliver.

The changes include but are not limited to:
[list]
[*] [b]Weapon Stats[/b] - Completely redone with new effects and more obvious impact in-game (functional and visual)
[*] [b]Soul Crest[/b] - Made more powerful and are more seamless to execute.
[*] [b]Artifices[/b]  - Two new traversal artifices that help you with platforming challenges (and maybe combat too!).
[*] [b]New Enemy Waves[/b]
[/list]

The new demo is live and we would love it if you guys give it a try and let us know what you think either on Steam Discussions or on our [url=https://discord.gg/ayxbBuwRbp]Disord[/url].

Additionally, we are aware that the default keyboard controls are a little inconvenient and will be fixing them soon, till then, kindly remap them according to your personal preference. 

Thank you so much for all the support so far :)

Love,
Team Brewed Games

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Folks![/b]
Over the course of development we have received several questions regarding Winds of Arcana: Ruination, so with this FAQ post we answer the most recurring ones!

Q. [b]Will it be out on PS/Xbox/Mobile?[/b]
A. Yes! Although the launch will be PC first, we will be porting the game to Playstation and Xbox, and even have plans to bring it to IOS and Android! Additionally, we are figuring things out for Switch as well.

Q. [b]Will there be multiple weapons? Magic? Skill tree? Customizability?[/b]
A. Yes, yes, sort of yes and yes!
[list]
[*] We plan to have 3 different class of weapons, sword, hammer and chakrams, with at least 3 in each category, so 9 in total. Each will be unqiue in their own way.
[*] There will be spells and that too tons of them! They can be obtained by collecting in game items called [i]Soul Crests[/i].
[*] Player skills would be unlocked by exploration (with ability gate items) and the [i]Soul Crests[/i] will have skill trees.
[/list]
Q. [b]DEMO!?[/b]
A. We are currently working on the demo which we plan to release sometime around the beginning of April 2024.

Q. [b]Will it have controller support and control remapping?[/b]
A. Yes, the game will have full controller support along with the option to customise them.

Q. [b]Will there be multiplayer/co-op?[/b]
A. Currently we are completely focused on a single player experience and have not planned any multiplayer/co-op experience.

Q [b]How long will the game time be?[/b]
A.We have 15-20 hrs of gameplay planned.

Q [b]Where to follow the development process?[/b]
A. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2201910/view/4123679333871680375]Here[/url] is the link to the post listing all our socials.

Those were the ones that needed answering the most, if you have any other questions, you may join our [url=https://discord.gg/ayxbBuwRbp]Discord[/url] and ask us directly or simply comment below! :)
Also, a reminder to [b]wishlist [/b]if you haven’t already!

Cheers!
Team Brewed Games
